systems.system: Système d'Information et de Gestion de l'Education (SIGE)
systems.owner: the three education ministries' planning directorates with the INS; run essentially on partners' financing (PRAASED/World Bank, PASSE, UNESCO), with no national budget line
systems.tiers: central only: not deconcentrated to the 12 departments, geographic coverage incomplete; collects yearly school questionnaires on paper for the statistical yearbooks and the carte scolaire

systems.owner: MEPPSA with the INS; produced technically and financially by partners (PRAASED for 2017-18 to 2020-21, PASSE for 2022-23)
systems.tiers: national; tables of raw data collected from schools once a year

systems.system: Base de données au MEPPSA couvrant les 3 ministères
systems.owner: MEPPSA, set up with PASSE support

systems.tiers: planned: every school with a unique identifier, updated for openings and closures before the 2026-27 school census

note: The compact (July 2024) describes the SIGE only as the yearly school census on paper questionnaires feeding the statistical yearbooks, so it is class census; it says pupil attendance is not collected, and lists pupil registration numbers (immatriculation des élèves) and online collection replacing paper questionnaires as aims of a future SIGE strategic plan, not as anything in place. No system in which schools add learner records is described, so no fact.
